page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number III at top right. Single column of verse, a centred small-capitals heading "AD ZANDEM." in the middle, then a stanza with a large initial S. Faint marginal marks only, no readable notes.

main_text.p: V os ad pectoris excubare portas
Nil eft, quem in lacrymis movere vultis
Non adeft animúfque córvę: ad illam
Donec vos ita luce reddat orbos,
Vt me corde animóque fecit orbum.
main_text.head: Ad zandem.
main_text.p: Sic iactor miser hue & huc timores

page.notes: Verse lines are set as paragraphs; the poem ends on this page. Several words in the Latin are doubtful due to faint print and show-through; e.g. "Neara", "Zandem" and the stanza-initial S. Marks of the reference "A" at the foot are not transcribed.
